description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the MenuService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing menu item retrieval for different user roles (Admin and Supervisor). It sets up test fixtures, mocks user authentication, and verifies the structure of menu items returned by the MenuService.

classes.name: MenuServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the MenuService component ensuring correct menu items based on user roles.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures from YAML files before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares a new instance of MenuService and disables I18N for each test.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForAdmin
methods.description: Tests menu retrieval for an admin user, verifying the full menu structure.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForSupervisor
methods.description: Tests menu retrieval for a supervisor user, verifying the structure suitable for limited access.
